definition_english: Extending a theoretical claim, logical argument, analytical model, or general comparison from one case to an analogous case while tacitly accounting for the obvious contextual or structural differences between the two.
definition_hindi: किसी तर्क, सैद्धांतिक निष्कर्ष, विश्लेषणात्मक प्रतिमान या तुलना को एक प्रकरण से दूसरे सदृश प्रकरण पर इस पूर्वधारणा के साथ विस्तारित करना कि दोनों प्रकरणों के स्पष्ट संदर्भगत अंतरों के अनुरूप आवश्यक समायोजन स्वतः मान लिए गए हैं।

etymology.english_origin: Unadapted borrowing from Late/Medieval Latin mūtātīs mūtandīs (British Latin 1272; English via Middle English c. 1525), an ablative absolute pairing perfect passive participle mūtātus ('having been changed') with gerundive of necessity mūtandus ('needing to be changed'), from Latin mūtāre ('to change').
etymology.pie_root: *mei- (1) ('to change, go, move'); Sanskrit cognate methati ('changes, alternates, joins, meets'), alongside Latin mūtuus and migrāre.
etymology.hindi_components: Sanskrit tatsama components: यथावश्यक (yathā + āvaśyaka, savarṇa-dīrgha sandhi), यथोचित (yathā + ucita, guṇa sandhi), आवश्यक, परिवर्तन, plus compound postposition के साथ (or simple indeclinable सहित). Reported in the research notes (not independently verified): in Hindi Shabdsagar Vol. 5 p. 555, यथोचित is headworded while यथावश्यक is absent between यथावत् and यथावस्थित.

synonyms: with such changes as are necessary
with the respective differences having been considered

register_and_pragmatics.academic_register: Philosophy, economics, formal logic, and general scholarly prose
cultural_nuances: Wiktionary is reported to note that mutatis mutandis has become increasingly uncommon even in academic English since the 1950s (not independently verified)
In explanatory and encyclopedic Hindi prose, के साथ flows more naturally than compact statutory सहित
usage_restrictions: Do not confuse with ceteris paribus (अन्य बातें समान रहने पर), which holds other factors constant instead of adjusting contextual differences
Avoid agentive यथोचित परिवर्तन करके when the grammatical subject is an inanimate argument, model, or theorem
Deprecate adjectival/gerundive यथोचित परिवर्त्य due to part-of-speech mismatch
Do not use unglossed Devanagari transliteration (म्यूटैटिस म्यूटैंडिस / मूटाटीस मूटान्डीस) in scholarly Hindi prose
Do not apply feminine pluralization (*परिवर्तनें) or redundant *परिवर्तनों के सहित

linguistic_analysis.structural_shift: English uses an unadapted Latin ablative absolute as a clause-initial or parenthetical adverb; Hindi renders it as an invariable three-slot manner-adverbial postpositional phrase preferring the compound postposition के साथ for explanatory flow.
linguistic_analysis.cstt_status: No exact Hindi entry could be verified directly on CSTT portals: cstt.education.gov.in was inaccessible and shabd.education.gov.in returned no extractable entry. Opened university and IGNOU eGyanKosh PDFs for Sense 2 were reported inaccessible or did not expose target Hindi clauses.

conceptual_analysis.core_scope: Comparative analytical shorthand extending a thesis, proof, or economic/philosophical claim across analogous domains by assuming obvious structural adjustments are made.
conceptual_analysis.contrastive_boundaries: Strictly opposed to ceteris paribus (अन्य बातें समान रहने पर, holding background factors equal) and to verbatim replication (यथावत्, permitting zero alteration).

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both express necessary contextual adjustment with the explanatory compound postposition के साथ.
pairwise_comparison.difference: यथावश्यक adds the proportional limiter 'to the extent needed' and uses compact singular परिवर्तन; आवश्यक परिवर्तनों के साथ is plainer and mirrors Latin plural morphology.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: High in comparative and academic prose.

pairwise_comparison.difference: के साथ flows more naturally in explanatory, philosophical, and encyclopedic prose; सहित is a compact Sanskrit indeclinable typical of statutory and gazette syntax.

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both signal contextual adjustment when extending a claim or rule.
pairwise_comparison.difference: यथावश्यक limits adjustment to what is strictly necessary; यथोचित refers to what is fitting or appropriate, widening interpretive latitude.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: Interchangeable in general comparative prose; prefer यथावश्यक where analytical strictness is required.

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both describe cross-case transfer of a pattern or claim.
pairwise_comparison.difference: यथावश्यक परिवर्तन के साथ encodes selective adaptation, whereas यथावत् encodes verbatim replication without alteration (explicitly contrasted in Hindi Wikipedia, Gurukul).

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both are formal Latinate analytical qualifiers in economics and philosophy.
pairwise_comparison.difference: यथावश्यक परिवर्तन के साथ (mutatis mutandis) instructs the reader to adjust differing contextual features; अन्य बातें समान रहने पर (ceteris paribus) holds all other variables constant.
के साथ encodes an accompanying condition compatible with inanimate subjects (arguments, models); करके requires a human/volitional agent.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: Not interchangeable with inanimate theoretical subjects.

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Share root elements relating to modification.
pairwise_comparison.difference: परिवर्त्य is an adjectival gerundive ('modifiable'), not an adverbial modifier indicating completed adaptation.
